news.summary: TSMC has confirmed that it will locate approximately 30% of its most advanced chipmaking capacity in Arizona as part of a $265 billion investment. The company maintains that 70% of its capacity and core R&D will remain in Taiwan, describing this as a "silicon shield." This geographic concentration of critical supply chain assets persists despite the significant U.S. expansion.
